title: Destroy and remove a stack
summary: Use destroy --preview-only for a read-only resource deletion preview without --yes or --confirm-destroy. The same guard protects destroy, its preview and stack rm: a checked-in consumer blocks when origin_ip is empty or database_enabled is true; explicit origin_ip and database_enabled false make the VPS name only a live selector, which stays in use. Read both values under the namespace declared by infra/Pulumi.yaml; missing or invalid values refuse with repair instructions. Mutating destroy and stack rm still require exact stack confirmation.
